## Audit note

The citation completeness audit reports full primary provenance across all 16 branches (59 foundational references in the master database plus supplementary clinical and historical sources in the additions packs). Four claims were explicitly fortified with primary papers during that audit: PPO denaturation (Subramanian et al., 1999), L-theanine receptor affinity (Kakuda et al., 2002), opium trade chest quantities (Morse, 1926), and ERN amplitude delta (Hobson et al., 2017).
